text: Public health is a discipline that takes the health of the population as its research object and enhances the health level of the group by preventing diseases, promoting health and improving the environment. The course aims to cultivate students' mastery of the basic theories of public health, epidemiological investigation methods, the ability to analyze health policies and emergency response skills, and to make them professional talents competent for disease prevention and control, health management and the formulation of public health policies.
